card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS passages
card.fires_on: Words and word parts written in ALL CAPS, usually in the middle of an upper-case sentence such as a warning or a heading. Often a small word like TO or BE, or the middle of a longer word.

modes.label: Caps warning text
modes.description: Small linking words or word endings inside upper-case label warnings.
modes.example: CONTAINER MUST BE HELD UPRIGHT<< TO>> OBTAIN PROPER FLOW OF

modes.label: Caps headings
modes.description: Parts of upper-case titles or file-like headings in web text.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue in capitals, favouring upper-case header-like words such as DESCRIPTION, LINK and INFO.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is written entirely in capital letters, so the next word is expected to be in capitals too.
